answer.rationale: memory_73 on promotional pricing scores lowest (2/5) because it explicitly measures 'acquisition and revenue lift' without documenting retention, lifetime value, or margin preservation—the cornerstones of sustainable long-term revenue. Aggressive discounting often attracts price-sensitive customers with low stickiness, undercutting the sustainability criterion. memory_44 scores highest (5/5): enterprise sales-assisted conversion directly correlates with deal quality, ACV, and retention patterns typical of durable revenue. memory_57 (4/5) shows qualified revenue addition without retention harm, supporting sustainability. memory_31 (4/5) and memory_86 (3/5) improve activation and onboarding completion, supporting long-term engagement, though activation metrics alone don't guarantee revenue durability. memory_91 (3/5) boosts early engagement but lacks evidence on conversion to paying customers or revenue contribution. The durable memory as a whole is skewed toward acquisition tactics; only memory_44 and memory_57 strongly validate sustainable qualified revenue.
